title: Instagram's Story Algorithm Explained — Rules of the Game (Comment Code)
segs: A-roll dark set, Devin seated centre; 'INSTAGRAM STORY ALGORITHM' in glowing green game-style text across his chest with his story-ring avatar at the end of the line; a flowchart (profile icon -> pyramid) is already built above his head
glowing green headline is the caption and the device
hard cut at 0.0
voice only
BACKGROUND DIAGRAM BEHIND/ABOVE HIM: the algorithm flowchart sits in the dark frame above his head, behind the presenter, from the first frame
DIAGRAM FULL-SCREEN, then 'RULES' in glowing blue pixel text with three bullets: ENGAGEMENT (red) / WATCH TIME (blue) / SKIP RATE % (yellow), over a blurred diagram background
RULES list is the text; no speech captions in this beat
hard cut to diagram
voice over the diagram
FRAME REPLACED BY GRAPHIC: first the flowchart, then the RULES title card fills the frame over a blurred diagram backdrop — Devin is gone

ANIMATED DIAGRAM BUILD: Devin's face inside a story ring at top, a line drops to a follower pyramid of person icons — the small top triangle lights up and is labelled as the most-interacting followers, 'FOLLOWERS' under the pyramid; an ENGAGEMENT row of percentage gauges builds underneath
diagram labels (FOLLOWERS / ENGAGEMENT and the top-triangle callout) are the text
no cut — one continuous diagram build
voice over the build
FRAME REPLACED BY GRAPHIC: the black diagram canvas fills the frame; his face exists only as the story-ring avatar inside the diagram

NEGATIVE BRANCH PERFORMED: hands hold a phone and tap through story rings, a story opens and is swiped away; the tray circles grey out, the background floods red, and the follower pyramid turns solid RED with a 'never see it' callout; Devin's story icon sits dimmed in the tray
red pyramid callout is the device text; phone UI text
hard cut to phone
voice over; story audio inside the phone is not heard

HAND/PROP B-ROLL: two hands holding a phone tapping and swiping a story, full-screen cutaway; ~14-19s inside this segment; lands on 'if they don't open it, or swipe away'; in = hard cut to phone, out = cut to the red diagram; sound = his voice over
FRAME REPLACED BY GRAPHIC/PHONE: the phone insert, then the red-flooded diagram with the red pyramid fills the frame — the negative outcome is a background colour state, not a caption

POSITIVE BRANCH PERFORMED: hands hold the phone again, the same story is watched through; beside the phone a checklist lights up line by line as he names each action: STICKER (with a sticker card on the story) / LIKE (heart) / COMMENT (keyboard) / SHARE / REPLY
checklist lines beside the phone are the device text, lighting in sequence
hard cut to phone
voice over; taps unconfirmed as SFX

HAND/PROP B-ROLL (repeat device): hands + phone watching a story to the end, full-screen cutaway; ~22.5-31.6s; lands on 'stick with it till the end, and interact with the sticker, leave a like, comment, share, or reply'; in/out = hard cuts; sound = his voice over
GRAPHICS BESIDE THE PHONE INSERT: the STICKER/LIKE/COMMENT/SHARE/REPLY checklist builds in the black space beside the phone, not over the story itself
DIAGRAM PAYOFF: the story tray row — Devin's ringed avatar glows GREEN and moves to the front/1st position; below it the follower pyramid lights up fully GREEN with an 'all followers' callout
tray position labels and the green pyramid callout are the text
hard cut to diagram
voice over the payoff
FRAME REPLACED BY GRAPHIC: the black diagram canvas fills the frame; the green state of the ring and pyramid is the payoff, carried by colour

A-roll return, warm room with fairy lights and a fireplace: 'NOW YOU KNOW / THE RULES TO THE GAME'; a glowing green 'CHEATCODES' game pill appears at his chest and a story-templates board (rows of story thumbnails) materialises in his open palm; a comment pill 'Code' and an IG notification 'Here's your Story Templates' float in; close holds on 'YOU NOW KNOW'
phrase chunks; CHEATCODES pill, comment pill and notification banner are device text
hard cut (return to face)
voice only
FLOATING DEVICES OVER FOOTAGE: the CHEATCODES pill, the templates board in his palm, the comment pill and the delivery banner all sit over the A-roll, never behind him and never over his face
